# Advisories accepted for the e2e_tests scan only. The e2e scan reads this file
# together with govulncheck-allowlist.txt; the xiond scan does not read it, so
# an entry here never hides a finding that is reachable from the chain binary.
#
# An entry belongs here only when its rationale is that the vulnerable code runs
# in the test harness and nowhere in xiond. Same rules as the shared file: every
# entry has a reason, and an entry with a fix available says where it is tracked.

# --- Dependencies with a fix available -------------------------------------

              # e2e_tests/go.mod documents why: v1.17.x drops trie/utils, which
              # cosmos/evm still imports. Reopens when cosmos/evm moves off it.

# --- No fix available ------------------------------------------------------
GO-2026-4883  # docker/docker v28.5.2. interchaintest drives local containers in
              # CI, not anything reachable from the chain.
GO-2026-4887  # docker/docker v28.5.2. As above.
GO-2025-3684  # cosmos/evm partial precompile state writes. The advisory carries
              # no symbol data, so govulncheck calls it reachable on import
              # alone. interchaintest imports only cosmos/evm/crypto -- nothing
              # from x/vm or the precompiles.
